HM.rules: A lived-in but tidy contemporary home interior at real residential scale (ceiling about 2.7 m), furniture placed along the walls so the centre of the floor stays clear.
HM.negatives: No children's rooms, no toys, no school items, no family photos, no posters with faces, no television showing an image, no clutter in the centre of the floor.

PB.rules: A generic commercial or public interior, open for business but empty of people, with a clear walkway in the centre.
PB.negatives: No classrooms or school buildings, no hospital beds or medical procedures, no product packaging with lettering, no menus or price boards with text, no recognisable chain-store design, no airline or transit-operator marks.

UR.rules: A generic city exterior that could be in many cities, with a clear stretch of pavement or ground in the centre.
UR.negatives: No real landmark or identifiable skyline, no cars driving through the centre, no readable shop signs, no street names, no licence plates, no traffic accidents, no graffiti lettering.

NT.rules: A natural landscape with a clear, walkable patch of ground in the centre (path, sand, grass, rock or snow) on which a person could stand.
NT.negatives: No buildings unless stated, no fences or power lines, no named or recognisable natural landmark, no wild animals, no birds in flight in the foreground, no fantasy elements.

RS.rules: An original holiday or travel photo spot of the stated kind, built as a generic place rather than any real resort, island, town or landmark, tidy and inviting, with a clear stretch of dry ground or deck in the centre well back from any edge or water.
RS.negatives: No real resort, hotel, island village or landmark, no hotel or shop names, no lettering on boats, walls or tiles, no temples, shrines, churches, domes, bell towers or offerings, no carved statues, no people on loungers or in the water, no branded pool floats, umbrellas or towels, no vehicles, no drones.

HS.rules: A historically accurate setting of the stated period and region, built as an original generic place rather than a copy of a real site, with period-correct materials and no modern objects.
HS.negatives: No temples, shrines, churches or other places of worship, no altars, no religious statues or symbols, no real palace or monument, no electric light in settings before the 1890s, no cars, no modern signage, no mixing of periods.

FT.rules: An original fantasy or science-fiction location that is physically plausible as a built or natural place, with a clear floor or ground in the centre.
FT.negatives: Original design, not any existing game, anime, film or franchise location; no glowing magic effects in the centre, no creatures, no robots, no spacecraft insignia, no readable holograms or screens.

ST.rules: A photographic studio set seen only as its backdrop and floor: no lights, stands, cables or equipment in frame, the backdrop filling the whole background.
ST.negatives: No visible studio equipment, no props, no furniture unless stated, no text.
